Name: Adventurer's Guild Recolor
Author: n0vacanes
Description:
originally, this started as a personal project because i wanted to decorate around the guild but nothing i wanted to use matched the building itself. i searched nexus but didn’t really find anything so now here we are, months later, guild recolor cradled preciously in my hands.


[center]-[/center]
[center][b]installation:
[/b]unzip into your mods folder. run the game once[b] [/b]with it installed to generate the config.json file.[/center][center]-[/center]
[center][b]options:[/b]

[b]blue[/b]
dark vanilla (no holiday decor)
dark holiday**
light vanilla (no holiday decor)*
light holiday*

[b]purple[/b]
dark vanilla (no holiday decor)*
dark holiday*
light vanilla (no holiday decor)*
light holiday*
[size=1]
**default selection
*missing screenshots for spring/summer (will update with them soon-ish!)[/size]
-[/center][b]
[/b][center][b]compatibility:[/b]
this mod replaces the guild building from the vanilla tilesheets, so there shouldn’t be compatibility issues with any other mods unless the same portion of the tilesheet is being augmented. this includes any expansions that may move the location of the guild building (for reference, i have sve, rsv, passerby cemetery, vmv, and cape stardew installed without issues).

-[/center]

[center]a huge HUGE thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/SeaSea50]SeaSea50[/url]﻿ for help with the code – these assets were going to end up rotting away on a hard drive without their help.

[size=2]and a thanks to my husband for the big brain idea to add holiday decorations for fall and winter, and for listening to my laments for months while working on this mod <3[/size][/center]


i would love to do more colors, but don’t want to promise anything because i do most of this stuff in ms paint & gimp and there is only so much single pixel clicking i can do before it starts driving me a tiny bit bonkers. never say never tho! because i definitely think marlon and gil would like to repaint the building pink for funsies.


[size=2]if you’re interested i do have a couple other mods :3
